item.title: Streaming Passes for the Brooklyn SciFi Film Festival — Mon Oct 5, 9:00 AM
item.description:
The Sci Fi Book Club Hi everybody!
[The Brooklyn SciFi Film Festival](https://brooklynscififilmfest.com/) kicks off its seventh season with over 200 independent Sci-Fi films from 34 countries streaming online for two weeks. The festival is an annual celebration of independent science fiction filmmaking, and over the years, BSFFF has highlighted hundreds of bold voices in the genre.
Grab your digital pass on Eventbrite to unlock a Netflix-style platform that you can search by category and even host virtual watch parties with friends.
